effects.effect: At the start of a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite), you can inspire yourself or another creature taking the same [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite) with divine knowledge. If the target makes a [project roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.downtime/project-roll) during this [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite), they can add 1d10 plus your [Presence](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/presence) score to the roll.
